name: Rogue Drone
storyline: A lone drone breaks free from a collective machine network and establishes a fragile settlement around its Core. Each day it gathers resources and builds defenses, while at night waves of hostile drones attempt to reclaim and destroy the Core. As the swarm grows stronger, survival depends on careful preparation and efficient automation.
summary:
Rogue Drone is a top-down sci-fi strategy game that blends tower defense, base building, and resource management into a single survival loop.

Gather resources and expand your outpost during the day, then defend it against escalating waves of hostile drones at night. Build and optimize your base layout, manage energy distribution, and deploy defensive systems to withstand increasingly dangerous attacks.

Harvest crystal resources, refine them into higher tiers, and unlock new technologies to strengthen your defenses. Every decision shapes your long-term survival as enemy waves grow in complexity and intensity.

With a focus on planning, automation, and deterministic combat, Rogue Drone challenges players to design efficient systems that can survive without direct control when the night begins.
